subject: Quantifying concessions vs. integration effort for potential switch
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@vertexscale.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluating Redwood for a potential replace - pricing + migration support

Hi Rachel,

Were evaluating alternatives to our current inference provider (TensorCloud) and wanted to see if Redwood can provide a competitive commercial package + migration assistance. High level: were ~420k ARR today with most spend on embeddings and chat generation; security requires SOC2 + VPC options.

Question: can you match or materially beat our current blended effective price, and do you offer migration credits or dedicated onboarding support for switching vendors?

If it helps, I can share a rough breakdown of our current bill and the most painful integration tasks. Looking to decide in the next 3 weeks.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform
VertexScale

--
attachment: none
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@vertexscale.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood for a potential replace - pricing + migration support

Hi Liam,

Thanks for the note and for the context. Weve helped a number of customers migrate from TensorCloud-style setups; short answer — yes, we can put together a package that combines a price concession with migration support, but the mix depends on two things wed like to quantify quickly:

- Current contractual commitment and remaining term
- Approx split of spend: embeddings vs chat vs reranking, and peak qps/avg seq length
- Integration pain: custom auth, data egress encryption, existing KV/cache formats, and any on-prem/VPC networking needs

If youre open to it Id like to get a short worksheet from you (approx numbers) and set a 30 minute call tomorrow to align on the MA Plan (mutual action plan). That will let us present a concrete concession vs. integration-lift table.

Provisional offer were comfortable exploring internally: year-1 blended discount + a one-time migration credit; details to be firmed after the quick scoping call.

When works for you?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

--

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@vertexscale.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Drake <procurement@vertexscale.io>
Date: 2027-06-30T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood for a potential replace - pricing + migration support

Thanks, Rachel. Call tomorrow at 11 PT works. Quick numbers attached (high level):
- Current ARR: $420,000
- 65% embeddings workload, 30% chat gen, 5% reranking/other
- Peak throughput ~120 qps, median seq length embeddings 512, chat sequences avg 230 tokens
- Must maintain SOC2 Type II, VPC connectivity, and data retention controls for 3 years

Were particularly worried about:
- API changes for batched embedding calls (we use a custom batching wrapper)
- KV migration for our prefix caches
- Exporting historical logs for auditors (egress costs)

I attached a quick migration worksheet with our best guesses.

Liam

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@vertexscale.io>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed commercial and operational package

Hi Liam — looping in a proposed, scoping-level package so you have something concrete to review ahead of the call. We can refine after the MA Plan call tomorrow.

High level proposal (scoping):
- Year 1: 18% off list across inference (tokens) and embeddings, conditional on a 12-month commit (annualized).
- One-time migration credit: $20,000 applied to professional services (onboarding + integration).
- 2 weeks of complimentary runbook/ops pairing for your SREs (up to 40 hours).
- Pilot option: 30-day pilot (up to $10k consumption) at no charge if you commit to the 12-month deal within 30 days.
- Packaging recommendation: Dedicated pool for embeddings (to stabilize latency) + shared-hosted for lower-priority chat bursts. Quantified pricing in the attached spreadsheet.

Were assuming SOC2 + VPC are table stakes; if there are additional compliance needs or custom HSM/KMS, that will affect the migration credit sizing.

Operational notes (integration risk / expected effort):
- Embedding batching wrapper: 1-2 engineer-weeks to adapt (we can provide a reference client patch).
- KV prefix migration: 2-3 engineer-weeks, can be parallelized; we offer a small migration agent as part of PS.
- Audit log extraction: depends on retention window and format; recommend a short discovery to scope egress costs.

Next steps: if that looks close, Rachel will send a one-page MA Plan + switch playbook and we can align timelines.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

--
attachment: migration_estimate.xlsx
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@vertexscale.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Drake <procurement@vertexscale.io>
Date: 2027-07-01T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial and operational package

Appreciate the rapid turnaround — this feels like the right structure. A couple asks before we lock timelines:

1) Can you provide a line-item estimate for the one-time integration effort (engineering weeks) broken down by task (batching, KV migration, egress preparation)? We need that for our internal migration cost model.
2) We will need a documented egress playbook that shows typical export times/costs and how you handle PII scrubbing during export. Do you have a published playbook or a runbook we can review?
3) Pilot terms: clarify what counts toward the $10k pilot budget (consumption only? GST? support hours?) and whether pilot consumption will be throttled to protect production.

If you can send a one-page MA Plan and the egress/runbook link before EOD tomorrow that would help us move faster.

Thanks,
Liam

--

Date: 2027-07-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial and operational package — MA Plan and playbook links

Liam, Alyssa —

Thanks — attached is a concise MA Plan and our switch playbook. Quick bullets answering your asks:

- Integration effort (line-item, scoping-level):
  * Embedding batching adapter: 1 engineer-week (reference patch provided)
  * KV prefix migration: 2 engineer-weeks with our migration agent (parallelizable)
  * Audit log export + PII remediation: 1-2 engineer-weeks depending on retention exports
  * Total expected internal eng effort: 4-5 engineer-weeks; PS can absorb the first 2 weeks under the $20k credit.

- Egress/runbook: https://docs.redwood.com/switch-playbook includes sample export times, checksum validations, and PII scrubbing options.

- Pilot terms: the $10k credit covers only consumption charges (tokens and ingestion) during the 30-day pilot; support hours beyond standard onboarding are billable unless consumed from the migration credit. Pilot environments are isolated and can be throttled at your request.

Attachments: redwood_switch_cheatsheet.pdf (one-pager), migration_estimate.xlsx (detailed numbers).

Next steps: please confirm (1) you'd like the pilot kicked off and (2) a target go/no-go date. Well then generate the HubSpot deal (HS-789213) and a statement of work draft.

Looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
